issue.close_reason: Delivered tests/concurrency_recovery_variants.rs in commit b0d2bca, pushed to origin/main: 11 tests, all passing (11 passed; 0 failed in 15.66s), each driving BOTH pins (pre_feature 0.2.4 + attempt_resolution_f25ab5c 0.2.6) with per-process sha256+embedded-version provenance checks. Acceptance mapping: (1) concurrent replay - parallel replays of one checkpoint converge across targets, replays into one shared target elect exactly one winner with clean no-mutation refusals, replay is idempotent and hop-stable, checkpoints replay across variants in both directions; (2) stale fencing/revision - four racing --if-revision writers admit one winner with exit-4 conflicts and a loser re-fences successfully, lease takeover issues a strictly greater fencing token and the stale/forged token is refused for update and release while the current holder lands; (3) checkpoint resilience - suppressed publication lags visibly and sync flush-only recovers full coverage, publication failure after a committed mutation splits honestly (exit 1, stdout preserved, remedy named) without rollback, corrupted pointer reports root_verified false and republish rebuilds, damaged generation refuses restore untouched while the retained previous generation recovers; (4) restore modes - sharded and monolithic checkpoints published under suppression restore through both bead restore and sync import-only. The inherited draft needed real fixes to run: uppercase --prefix tags are rejected by the pins, the fencing-refusal loop passed --notes after --fencing-token so clap read the note text as the token value (exit 2 masked as a fencing refusal), and two args arrays mixed String and &str inference. Verification method: the suite is deliberately lib-free (it drives the pinned executables only), and HEAD does not currently build a binary - src/service/attempt.rs:469 at HEAD calls lifecycle::release_issue_in_tx, which exists only in an uncommitted working-tree diff - so the suite was run from an extraction of committed HEAD plus this test file in a standalone harness crate wired to pinned-binaries/; flagging the broken HEAD lib for the quality-gate children. Rival in-flight files (concurrent_replay_fencing.rs, checkpoint_resilience.rs) were left untouched for their dispatches.

issue.description:
Artifacts:
- Transactional service that revalidates one scanner finding and replaces only its selected bytes with the fixed redaction marker.
- Workspace maintenance/checkpoint locking and idempotent receipt lookup.
- Supported selectors for issue fields, event detail, comments, structured data, attempt evidence, and recovery receipts.

Acceptance:
- No caller supplies or receives the matched bytes.
- One transaction changes only the exact target, records the receipt, and preserves all semantic identities and unrelated bytes.
- Identical replay returns the original receipt; changed/stale target, unsupported field, or fingerprint mismatch conflicts without mutation.
- Concurrent mutation, crash-before/after-commit, range/Unicode, repeated occurrence, no-value-output, and byte-for-byte unaffected-state tests pass plus full Rust gates.
